messages:
Alex: Heads-up 1h til marketplace preflight. Need to align press embargo, SI dry-run windows, and hardware image handoff. Quick check: press kit owner?
Priya: Press kit + hero assets mostly done. Waiting on partner hardware quote and legal blurb. I can publish preview link when signed.
PartnerOps: Partner requested regional AMI list + preferred time for APAC verification. Can we give eu-west-1 AMIs by EOD?
Mateo: Infra can push AMIs. Please share instance types and exact IDs needed.
LegalBot: Legal needs the partner quote verbatim for sign-off. Also confirm embargo window length.
Priya: Proposed embargo = go-live + 20 minutes. Is that ok?
LegalBot: That works. Add: "Do not publish before 2025-05-02T14:30:00Z" to the press kit.
Alex: SI dry-run slots proposal:
```
- Tue 08:00-09:30 UTC: EU smoke
- Tue 10:30-12:00 UTC: APAC connectivity test
- Tue 13:00-14:30 UTC: End-to-end with SI / partner
```
Mateo: We'll hold non-critical deploys for those windows. Deploy freeze set by Infra (tag=marketplace-preflight).
InfraBot: Deploy freeze scheduled window=1765558200-1765565400 UTC :lock: 
PartnerOps: I'll push AMI request now and ask partner for quote by 18:00 PT. If not received, we use generic hardware blurb.
Alex: Actions:
- Priya: share press preview (ETA 18:30 PT)
- Mateo: confirm AMI push + instance types (ETA 17:00 PT)
- PartnerOps: chase partner quote (ETA 18:00 PT)
React with :thumbsup: or flag blockers.
